criteria.title: Investigate stack protection, fortification, PIE, RELRO, and executable-memory policy.
criteria.task: Compare plain and hardened original Linux binaries using ELF headers,dynamic tags,guard/check sites and process mappings. Demonstrate an intentional local bounds defect with a repaired control where supported.
criteria.purpose: ASLR,NX,RELRO or a canary repairs the underlying bounds defect.

security.scope: Original local teaching targets and synthetic data only; the exact leaf task and contract constrain execution.

security.isolation: No network listener, third-party target, real data, credentials, operational equipment or privileged host changes. Use a private temporary directory for filesystem work and a separate process for intentional memory defects; bound input, time and memory.

security.exploitability_limits: No altered ASLR policy, permissions or host security; any UB demonstration is confined to the original isolated process and is not arbitrary execution evidence
security.success_condition: Actual markers/enforcement and defect repair are distinct; a crash or detection is not claimed as arbitrary execution.
security.repair: Repair the root extent/lifetime defect, then retain supported compiler/linker/runtime mitigations and link audits
security.regression: Run the exact original-versus-repaired discriminator and ordinary valid operation; preserve required state on rejection. Actual markers/enforcement and defect repair are distinct; a crash or detection is not claimed as arbitrary execution.
